analysis.incidentSummary: Critical database connection pool exhaustion in payment-service causing cascading 502/503 service failures up the gateway stack.
analysis.probableRootCause: Payment service exceeded the maximum database pool capacity (100 active connections). Inbound checkout transactions are timing out after 5000ms attempting to acquire a lease.
